method.name: B — GOLD plus calibrated SILVER proxy
method.unit: city score is the maximum score of its real Signal/DesignationEvent nodes
method.base: per eligible node: +2 early stage (avis_motion|projet_reglement), +2 residential-eligible (isResidentialEligible), +2 zoning=yes; all three must hold on the same node to reach 6
method.bonus: +2 bounded urban regulatory reform and +2 explicit regulation-number reference, awarded only after the 6-point intersection; bonuses never admit a node
method.target: for SILVER positives, measured count of nodes in the three-way intersection

_meta.no_graph_key_exception: The 5 UNMATCHED rows have no graph_city_slug; their canonical cohort slug is used only as a unique JSON key and is not asserted as a graph slug.
_meta.anti_invention: Only real SCW graph nodes are scored. Six GOLD verdicts are copied from Steve verbatim. Five cities without graph_city_slug remain null and unscored. No graph, score, target, or verdict is fabricated.

gold_meta.verite_terrain: GOLD — évaluation humaine Steve (30 villes). Anti-invention : verdict repris tel quel ; slugs résolus contre les dossiers graphes SCW réels.
gold_meta.in_bprime: true = ville attendue DANS B′ (Steve ≥ seuil / ✓N) ; false = faux positif attendu DEHORS (✗0)
gold_meta.target: compte-cible Steve (informatif — mesuré sur la donnée de Steve ; le compte sur graphes frais peut différer légitimement). Le gate DUR = in_bprime (in/out).
ambigus_hors_gate_dur: hemmingford--les-jardins-de-napierville / --2 : slug ambigu (3 doublons DB, verdict Steve 0/0/1) — à assainir, hors gate dur
notre-dame-de-lourdes--joliette : slug ambigu (Joliette vs L'Érable) — hors gate dur ; --lerable seul est gold ✓2
